## Problem

What observed behavior or documentation problem does this address?

## Change

Why is this the smallest complete change that fixes it?

## Evidence

List the prompts, isolated runs, diffs, checks, or reader validation performed.

## Non-goals

What related work was deliberately left out?

## Checklist

- [ ] I read the complete diff.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private transcripts, or data I cannot publish.
- [ ] Skill metadata and conditional references remain consistent.
- [ ] Installation remains idempotent and preserves unrelated global guidance.
- [ ] Public claims do not exceed the evidence.
